_about: Corrections to how an item looks on Dave's 2D drawing and 3D model, for shop photos the page reads wrongly. Keyed by item id (as in data/items*.json). Fields: col and col2 (#rrggbb, the main and second colour as the shop photo shows the cloth in daylight), pat (plain, hstripe, vstripe, check or print), per and duty (stripe spacing and stripe width, as shares of the garment's length), front:false (never lay the shop photo's own front on the garment), decal:false (no chest print or logo), why (what the shop photo shows, and what was read wrongly), checked (YYYY-MM-DD). tools/build_site.py refuses the build if an entry is malformed. See CONTRIBUTING.md, 'Correcting how an item looks'.

sw-open-polo.why: A flat-lay of a navy knitted polo on a grey gradient background; part of the background was read as cloth, giving a grey panel on the chest and lilac sleeves.

r7-tl-keir.why: The listing is a set: one photo of a black tee over grey marl shorts. Taken as the tee's front, the shorts showed as a band across the bottom of the tee, and the shorts drew black; the tee is black and the shorts grey marl.

next-epsom.why: A model shot of a dark navy wool overcoat ('Blue Navy'); the photo is not used for its colour, and the name read as mid blue from its first word.

universalt-fear-of-god-essentials-mens-e.why: A flat-lay of a pale canary-yellow sweatshirt with its sleeves laid down over the body; on white the sleeves' edges are too faint to be seen as sleeves, so the photo front put their outlines on his chest.

hs-bb-shirwell.why: A lifestyle photo by the sea: a mid-blue resort shirt with thin white stripes. The sky and sea behind the model were read into the cloth, which came out grey.

urbanexces-no-problemo-glitch-scarf-lila.why: A flat-lay of a dark navy and purple jacquard scarf with lettering; the listing's 'Lilac' made it light lilac, but the cloth reads as a deep blue-purple.

ms-cord-pleat.why: A model shot of ecru cords (the listing's colour is ECRU) on a pale grey backdrop almost the same colour, so the backdrop took the trousers and the black jumper and belt above them were read; they drew brown.

fa-netherton-cord.why: A model shot of an ecru cord shirt worn open over a beige tee; the middle of the photo is the tee, which was read as the shirt's colour.
